name: Anthropic Backend
description: Anthropic backend for Level 3 translation and calibration. Provides a wrapper around the Anthropic API client for completing chat messages using Claude models.

types.name: AnthropicBackend

fields.name: _api_key
fields.description: Anthropic API key, sourced from parameter or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var

fields.name: _model
fields.description: Model identifier, sourced from parameter or TRANSMOG_MODEL env var with default 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'

types.description: Backend class that interfaces with Anthropic's API for chat completions. Lazy-loads the client on first use.

functions.name: __init__
functions.description: Initializes the AnthropicBackend with optional API key and model. Falls back to environment variables ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and TRANSMOG_MODEL, with a default model of 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'. Client is not instantiated until first use.

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.description: Optional API key for Anthropic. If None, reads from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var, defaults to empty string

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Optional model identifier. If None, reads from TRANSMOG_MODEL env var, defaults to 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'

postconditions: _api_key is set to provided value or environment variable or empty string
_model is set to provided value or environment variable or 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'
side_effects: reads environment variables ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and TRANSMOG_MODEL

structured_side_effects.description: Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and TRANSMOG_MODEL from os.environ

functions.name: _ensure_client
functions.description: Lazy initialization method that creates the Anthropic client if it hasn't been created yet. Imports the anthropic module and instantiates the client with the stored API key.

error_cases.name: AuthenticationError
error_cases.condition: _api_key is invalid or empty when client is instantiated

side_effects: instantiates anthropic.Anthropic client with stored API key

structured_side_effects.description: Sets _client to anthropic.Anthropic instance if currently None

functions.name: complete
functions.description: Sends a chat completion request to Anthropic's API. Ensures the client is initialized, constructs the message payload with model, max_tokens, messages, and optional system prompt, then returns the text content from the first response block.

inputs.name: system
inputs.description: System prompt for the conversation. Only included in API call if non-empty

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: List of message dictionaries with role and content keys

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Maximum tokens to generate in the response

error_cases.name: APIError
error_cases.condition: Anthropic API returns error response (invalid model, rate limit, etc.)

error_cases.name: IndexError
error_cases.condition: response.content is empty or does not contain expected structure

preconditions: messages is a non-empty list of valid message dictionaries
side_effects: makes network call to Anthropic API

structured_side_effects.description: Calls client.messages.create to generate chat completion
May initialize _client if not already set

invariants: Default model is 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001' if not specified
_client is None until first use, then remains initialized

data_access.rationale: Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and TRANSMOG_MODEL from environment. Makes network calls to external Anthropic API.

side_effects.rationale: Configuration sourced from environment variables as fallback
Sends chat completion requests to Anthropic's hosted service
